title: HP DeskJet AiO WSD Scan Buffer Overflow RCE (CVE-2026-4682)
description: Certain HP DeskJet All-in-One devices are vulnerable to remote code execution caused by a buffer overflow when specially crafted WSD (Web Services for Devices) scan requests are improperly validated. WSD Scan uses Microsoft WS-Scan protocol allowing network-based scan without vendor drivers. CVSS 8.7 (CVSSv4, AV:A).
author: Andre Henrique (@mrhenrike) | Uniao Geek
